A search result tied that exact title to the De Gruyter PDF page for this DOI, and it sits in the same *Theoretical Linguistics* 34(1) issue as Croft & Poole's main article, which is DOI 10.1515/THLI.2008.001 under a different title. I could not open the page to confirm the title directly, because the publisher's site refused the fetch, so check it on doi.org before citing.
